text_block_list.text: One day, when the footsteps of spring were beginning to be felt—

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text: —HAAAAH!!!
choice_data_list: (Alright...!!)

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text: Haa... haa... haa—

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text:
"...How was that, Trainer?!
My run just now!!"
choice_data_list: Yeah, you were absolutely perfect!
Yeah, it was perfect!

text_block_list.text: Leading up to today, Sounds of Earth has been able to build up solid ability and a strong track record.
With this... at long last...!
choice_data_list: Let's aim for the Classic races starting this spring!

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text: —Stupendoooo!!!!

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text: Direttore!!
choice_data_list: (Quickly pull out the maracas)

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text: Direttrice!!
choice_data_list: (Quickly pull out the maracas)

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
choice_data_list: (Shaka-shaka-shaka-shaka-shaka!!)

text_block_list.name: Academy Trainer
text_block_list.text:
...They seem to be having
a whole lot of fun playing over there.

text_block_list.name: Academy Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
Something really great must have happened.
She's even dancing—

Afterward, the meeting shifted toward
discussing specific next steps—
choice_data_list: Let's keep our long-term goal as the Japanese Derby

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text:
Sì! That shall become
the "theme" of our Classic year...!
choice_data_list: However, there's a race I want you to run before that.

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text:
Yes, yes, of course it would!
The melody alone cannot carry the whole piece...!

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text:
Now then—
How shall I wield my baton?
choice_data_list: Let's aim for the Kyoto Shimbun Hai!

text_block_list.text: —The Kyoto Shimbun Hai is a 2,200m GII turf race held at Kyoto Racecourse in May.

Many Umamusume aiming to run in the Japanese Derby
often run this race as a stepping stone...!

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text: —In other words, this is where we also test our mettle in preparation for the Nippon Derby...!

I nod in agreement. Our results in the Kyoto Shimbun Hai
will surely serve as strength for her
challenge in the Japanese Derby...!

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text:
Then let us face it with a majestic, heroic stride!
Yet holding an instrument close to our heart—
...And so, the Kyoto Shimbun Hai was decided as the next target race.
Later on, while having a meal out with Sounds of Earth—

text_block_list.name: Race Fan A
text_block_list.text:
—Hey, how do you think Gentildonna
will do in the Dubai G1 this year?!

text_block_list.name: Race Fan B
text_block_list.text: "She didn't seem to be in great shape for the Kyoto Kinen, but you still can't help hoping—"

text_block_list.name: Race Fan C
text_block_list.text:
“—Gold Ship is kicking off this year
with the Hanshin Daishoten, huh.
Her races are always so wild, I can't wait...!”

text_block_list.name: Race Fan D
text_block_list.text:
Ah~, if only Orfevre were here.
I wanted to see them duke it out even more...――
choice_data_list: (Everywhere you go, it's all talk about the older generation...)

text_block_list.text: "...On the way back to the academy, Sounds of Earth uncharacteristically seemed somewhat absent-minded."
choice_data_list: ...Lost in thought?
...Thinking about something?

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text:
Oops—how unlike me,
to get so lost in the sounds inside my head.

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text:
…………Direttore.
Care to take a little detour with me?

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text:
…………Direttrice.
Care to take a little detour with me?

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text:
At a leisurely pace...
There's something I'd like to ask you.
choice_data_list: ...Understood.

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text:
Mmm!
The sound the wind plays is so pleasant, yes—
choice_data_list: Yeah, there's a great view of the sky, feels nice.
Yeah, you can see the sky clearly, it feels great.

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text: ...Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text:
From your perspective, what do you think of my peers...
of our generation?

...To be honest, I couldn't grasp the true intent of the question.
However, I can tell from her calm tone
that it's a serious inquiry.
choice_data_list: I believe this is the generation that will blossom from here on out.

text_block_list.text:
Sounds of Earth and the others have only just entered the Classic Year.
They possess limitless potential to grow.

"That is precisely why I believe we shouldn't pass judgment on them just yet.
Besides—"
choice_data_list: I'm looking forward to it, too
I'm looking forward to it as well.

text_block_list.text: What kind of races will her generation, including Sounds of Earth, create from here on out? I feel nothing but pure anticipation...!

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text: —Benissimo!!!

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text:
Magnificent, Direttore...!
It's precisely because you are so full of love
that I want to walk alongside you...!
choice_data_list: Thank you. But why do you ask?

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text:
Magnificent, Direttrice...!
It's precisely because you are so full of love
that I want to walk alongside you...!
choice_data_list: Thank you. But why do you ask?

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text:
...It was a little while ago.
I had a chat with a classmate of mine—
—Sounds of Earth showed me the way.

That two of her generation-mates
had laid bare their anxiety towards the sheer brilliance
of the older generation—Orfevre and the others.

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text:
...Indeed, the musicians of the previous generation
are all truly brilliant.

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text: Meanwhile—

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text:
Lately, there have been rising stars in the younger generation who haven't even debuted yet,
attracting early attention due to their lineage and background...

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text:
"Amidst such circumstances, there are not a few in our generation
who feel uneasy about whether they will be able to shine in the future—"

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text:
"—To achieve the 'greatest session',
we'll need many 'greatest Umamusume' in this generation, including myself."

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text:
"To fret amidst all that over 'one's sound being buried,'
and let the melody of our generation become clouded, is—"

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text:
So very...! So very close...!!
Don't you agree, Trainer...!?
choice_data_list: Earth...

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text: So I gave it some thought. About how to make the upcoming race, and the running of the Umamusume participating in it, the absolute best—

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text:
“......I leave the rest to you,
Direttore.”

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text:
......I leave the rest to you,
Direttrice.

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text:
Would you please...
allow me to perform in an ensemble with everyone of my generation?
choice_data_list: Does that mean—

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text:
I want to polish our sound...!
Together with all of them!!

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text:
"All of us giving our best performance together
will become the power to create a session
that outshines even the brilliance of the generation above us...!"

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text: And in the end—

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text:
“—I'll guide my own melody to even greater heights!
It's bound to be the greatest race alongside everyone of my generation!”
Those words felt uniquely hers, seeing as she viewed races as "collaborative sessions created together with fellow runners."

Music only truly becomes music when all of its components
harmonize and flow together in succession.
Not a single element can ever be missing—
—In short, by cooperating with everyone, she hopes to encourage them, train together, and make future races the greatest they can be...!

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text: ......Am I being a bit too meddlesome, after all?
choice_data_list: No—

text_block_list.text:
I saw Earth's true essence in her thoughts.
That distinct way she has of loving racing itself—
choice_data_list: Let's try doing it the way you want, Earth

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text:
"Con amore...!!
Ah, why must you always be so...—"

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text:
—...Grazie, Trainer.
I will surely lead the way for you.

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text: To our greatest session ever...!!

And so, Sounds of Earth's ensemble
with everyone in his generation began—

text_block_list.name: Peerless Shout
text_block_list.text: —Yaaaaaah!!

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text: —HAAAAAH!!

text_block_list.name: Peerless Shout
text_block_list.text:
—Thanks for matching strides with me, Earth.
Thanks to you, I could clearly picture
a lot of things for the next race.

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text: You're welcome! But wow, your running is getting sharper and sharper...!

text_block_list.name: Peerless Shout
text_block_list.text:
...I just thought
I should follow Earth's example.

text_block_list.name: Peerless Shout
text_block_list.text: To be honest, I was getting a bit fed up with how everyone's been talking about our generation lately.

text_block_list.name: Peerless Shout
text_block_list.text: Still, Earth doesn't let things like that get to her, she just stays positive and works hard. Plus, she even helps me out—

text_block_list.name: Peerless Shout
text_block_list.text:
"...I'll look ahead just as much.
Otherwise, there's no way I'll win the Derby...!"

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, I'm honored to hear you say that.
After all, I was simply following your passionate feelings toward the Derby!

text_block_list.name: Peerless Shout
text_block_list.text:
Huh, is that so?
......That actually makes me kinda happy.

text_block_list.name: Earth's Classmate Umamusume A
text_block_list.text:
Ah, we sang our hearts out~!
Earth, thanks for joining me!

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text:
Brava!! Just like your running,
it was a truly passionate singing voice...!!

text_block_list.name: Earth's Classmate Umamusume A
text_block_list.text:
"No, no, Earth is just really good at hyping people up~!
Still, I feel so refreshed now."

text_block_list.name: Earth's Classmate Umamusume A
text_block_list.text:
For real, lately things just haven't been clicking and I felt like I hit a wall, y'know~?
Thanks to this, I feel like I've hit the reset button!

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, looks like you've got your energy back.
I'm down to train side-by-side anytime...!
Let's fire up our generation together!

text_block_list.name: Earth's Classmate Umamusume B
text_block_list.text:
One, two, three, four.
One, two, three, four!

text_block_list.name: Earth's Classmate Umamusume B
text_block_list.text:
W-We did it! I made it!
Thank you, Earth-san...!
It's all thanks to your advice!

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text:
"It's entirely the fruit of your own hard work, young lady.
Those were lovely steps.
So captivating, I couldn't take my eyes off you—"

text_block_list.name: Earth's Classmate Umamusume B
text_block_list.text:
A-Adorable, you say...? N-No way...!
...B-But with this, I feel like I can give it my all in the debut race Winning Live...!

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, what a heartbreaker you are.
That pure innocence of yours is dazzling, too.

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text:
—Please, go into your debut race with confidence.
You possess a light that is uniquely yours, second to none.

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text:
As someone of the same generation, I know that all too well.
Far better than you might think—

text_block_list.name: Earth's Classmate Umamusume B
text_block_list.text: Ah, Earth-san...—

text_block_list.name: Aurum Star
text_block_list.text: “—I hear you've been mingling with everyone from our generation quite a lot lately.”

text_block_list.name: Aurum Star
text_block_list.text:
What on earth are you up to?
Thanks to you, it feels like everyone's
spirits have somehow brightened up.

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text:
I merely shared and harmonized with everyone.
Bringing together each of our distinct sounds, you see.

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text: Of course, I'd love to harmonize with you as well.

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text: "And so, elevating one another, I want us to play it together someday. A melody that's uniquely ours—"

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text: A brilliant race that only we can achieve...!

text_block_list.name: Aurum Star
text_block_list.text:
"...I see.
So that is how you intend to guide our generation."

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text:
To say I'm "leading" is far from the truth!
This is an ensemble—

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text:
You layer each other's sounds together
to create a single piece of music.

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text:
"Because we run in the same races,
and we compete against each other in them."

text_block_list.name: Aurum Star
text_block_list.text:
Heh. Then I'll answer the call too.
Even if I'm trailing behind everyone else—

text_block_list.name: Aurum Star
text_block_list.text:
So that I can run brilliant races with all of you,
I'll keep training...! As a member of this generation!

text_block_list.name: Aurum Star
text_block_list.text:
Who cares about the older generation?!
We'll show 'em how we run!!

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text:
"Beni-ss-simo!!
Ah, let us strive together, shall we?!"

Little by little, yet steadily.
Each and every tone begins to harbor power.

And so, the day of Sounds of Earth's
Kyoto Shimbun Hai
drew steadily closer—
